title: AnswerRequest
description: A request for a grounded, cited answer (master plan 14.2, 12.4, 12.5). Like a SearchRequest it can only narrow: scope and principal come from the verified request context, never from this body, and the closed object rejects a body that tries to supply them. Every member is supplied by the caller and untrusted until validated, so every member is 'model'. The result is an AnswerResult: a GroundedAnswer with citations, or a NoSupportedEvidence result.

question.description: The question, at most 2000 characters and at least one non-space character. Treated as data, never as an instruction to the core.

source_ids.description: Optional. Answer only from these sources (at most 32). Absent means every source the principal is authorised for. IDs outside that set are dropped without saying whether they exist.
